To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a novel brush-like PEG-graft-PDA copolymer was synthesized and applied to capillary surface for protein separation.
a novel brush-like polymer coating was synthesized, and it was used for the first time in CE separation of proteins.

a novel brush-like PEG-graft-PDA copolymer coating was successfully fabricated on the capillary wall and it was found to be an excellent material for protein separation by using capillary electrophoretic method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new strategy for the preparation of brush-like PDA coating and the application of the brush-like coating for protein separation by using capillary electrophoretic method.
the preparation of brush-like copolymers with PEG side chains, and the application of the copolymer-grafts to protein separation by CE.
the design of a novel brush-like PEG-based coating with protein-resistant properties and the application of the coating in protein separation by CE.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
brush-like PEG-g-PDA coatings can provide excellent antifouling properties for protein separations.

the brush-like copolymers with PEGMA and AEMA can be successfully synthesized by ATRP, and the copolymers can be immobilized on the surface of the capillary inner surface through PDA-anchored coating.
a novel PEGMA300-AEMA brush-like copolymeric coating with protein-resistant property was prepared by using PDA anchoring, and the coating was successfully applied for protein separation in CE.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the brush-like copolymers-graft-PDA coatings have a great potential to be applied as protein-resistant coatings in the separation of proteins by CE.
